applied.problem: Claims go past their quotes: coin-toss drops 'most' testers; 30-50% drops 'for example'; 80% is two IEEE standards' recommendation; 'often the cause' is unsupported; sulphation needs long deprivation; grid corrosion is normal ageing that overcharge speeds up.

Specific gravity can only be read on vented cells, not valve-regulated ones; the 80% replacement rule is presented as absolute when the source says two IEEE standards recommend it; and overcharge speeds grid corrosion rather than being its only cause.

Screen 1 drops the quote's 'most' testers; screen 5 drops the service guide's 'for example'; screen 6's hint says the 20% line 'calls it a concern', which the maker does not say; screen 10's hint makes high voltage the only cause of grid corrosion, which also comes with normal age.
